kill_rule: If the pipeline already treats the denominator as a first-class estimand with its own error, the instance leaves DPC.

ranking.quantity: 2024 total striped bass catch (count of fish)
ranking.denominator_construct: Fishing Effort Survey private-boat and shore trips treated as observed
ranking.source: NMFS FES revision, 31 Aug 2026; Marine Fish Conservation Network 2 Oct 2026. 20,822,514 → 14,323,640 (−31.2%). Live releases 19,093,770 → 13,111,145 (−31.3%).
ranking.notes: No fish moved. Effort overreporting in two-month waves was the denominator. Catch = CPUE × effort. Management did not immediately change; the privileged number remains in the catch-limit machine until stock assessments re-ingest it.

ranking.denominator_construct: survey completeness / selection function treated as the observed search volume
ranking.source: Astronomy & Computing 57 (Oct 2026) art. 101170: raw HZ rates 0.33% F/G, 0.72% K, 4.03% M; completeness-corrected η⊕(K)=0.266, η⊕(M)=0.408; raw counts must be scaled 10–37×. Bryson et al. PASP; arXiv:2511.05658 (7 Nov 2025): published η⊕ spans >10×.
ranking.notes: Completeness correction is standard (spoken as method). DPC remainder: raw NASA Exoplanet Archive rates are still published and cited as occurrence. Different completeness models rewrite η⊕ by an order of magnitude with no planet appearing or disappearing.

ranking.quantity: named / cultured fraction of bacterial species
ranking.denominator_construct: discoverable species-level clades in unbinned contigs treated as the 'all microbes' set
ranking.source: Nature Microbiology (2 Apr 2026) DOI 10.1038/s41564-026-02314-6. 92,187 metagenomes; ~705,000 bacterial and ~27,000 archaeal species-level clades; 145 previously undescribed bacterial phyla discoverable; gap between discovered and discoverable is widening.
ranking.notes: The cultured fraction's denominator is not a fixed census. It grows with unbinned-contig clustering. More looking enlarges the denom; the named fraction falls. Remainder-Growth is queued, not minted. DPC owns the privilege of treating discoverable-set as 'all microbes'.

ranking.quantity: named fraction of ectomycorrhizal fungal species
ranking.denominator_construct: eDNA sequence clusters treated as the species census
ranking.source: van Galen et al., Current Biology, 9 Jun 2025. Up to 83% of ectomycorrhizal species are dark taxa (DNA only). SPUN: unnamed species cannot enter conservation initiatives. Channel >9 Gt CO2 / year.
ranking.notes: 'Dark taxa' is spoken as a conservation problem. DPC remainder: IUCN/legal machinery requires a name-token; the eDNA denom is refused admission. Adjacent to DCC (sequences already in the file) — overlap-penalized, not re-issued as DCC.

ranking.denominator_construct: undefined meaning-space treated as if repertoire-size were a language census
ranking.source: Sharma et al. Nature Communications (7 May 2024): 21 → ~156 codas. Beguš vowels, Open Mind 2025; Proc. B 14 Apr 2026. Meaning still unmapped.
ranking.notes: Weak DPC. Repertoire grew; the meaning-denominator was never issued. Adjacent to FAC (no discriminator for 'language'). Kept only as animal-realm unspoken: combinatorial structure is not a census of statements.

ranking.denominator_construct: national-accounts vs fiscal 'total income' treated as the same observed denom
ranking.source: Geloso, Magness & Sparks, working-paper revisit posted 4 Oct 2026 (SSRN 4532761 lineage). Roughly half of PSZ vs Auten–Splinter US inequality difference attributed to inconsistent income denominator.
ranking.notes: Human-realm instance. Not a physical unknown. Kept as runner because the mechanism (privilege of a construct denom) is the same. Does not license a social-science patent.

ranking.denominator_construct: deep seafloor area (~335.7 million km²) vs mapped vs sampled, collapsed into one 'explored' denom
ranking.source: Bell et al., Science Advances 11(19):eadp8602 (7 May 2025). DOI 10.1126/sciadv.adp8602. <0.001% visually observed; 65% of observations within 200 nm of US/Japan/New Zealand; 97% of dives by five countries.
ranking.notes: Bell measured the visual numerator correctly. DPC remainder is the spoken '90% of the ocean is unexplored' which uses a different, unspecified denom (mapped? sampled? visually seen?). Three denoms, one slogan.

ranking.denominator_construct: bowl size / population in a psychology experiment
ranking.source: Denes-Raj & Epstein 1994; Wikipedia 'denominator neglect' retrieved 2026-10-07. Cognitive bias, not a published natural quantity.
ranking.notes: Must score near zero. This is the spoken namesake. DPC is not ratio-bias in humans. It is privilege granted to a denom inside a scientific census of nature.

ranking.denominator_construct: photo-z posterior already treated as estimand
ranking.source: Euclid photo-z; DESI COSMOS-XMM. ANC/FPC control reused. Missing spectroscopic redshift is estimated with a posterior.
ranking.notes: Must score near zero. The denom is already a first-class estimand. Kill-rule analogue.
